name: The Swanee Theatre
tagline: Downtown Kannapolis live music and event venue
weekly_note: Schedules can change; the Swanee posts weekly updates on its social media.

rent.pitch: Weddings, conferences, concerts and parties in the heart of downtown, walking distance to restaurants, the ballpark and the Amtrak station. The marquee can carry your special message.
rent.rates_note: Tables, chairs and linens included. A $150 venue service charge applies to groups serving alcohol; sales tax may be added. More options (kitchen, green room, marquee message) on the rental page.

good_to_know: Most shows: doors open an hour before showtime.
Under 18 must be with a parent or guardian (check each show).
Full bar plus snacks for sale. Outside food is OK; outside drinks are not.
Free downtown parking nearby; the free West Avenue Express shuttle stops at the Swanee (5–10 p.m. Fri–Sun, April–December).
